lines.zh: 我离地半尺，踩着气滑过去。
lines.en: Half a pace off the ground, I ride my ki across.

lines.zh: 飞的时候，风把头发往后拉。
lines.en: Flying pulls my hair straight back.

lines.zh: 我从屋顶上掠过，没惊动谁。
lines.en: I skim the rooftops without waking anyone.

lines.zh: 脚下一沉，我落到巷子里。
lines.en: I drop and land in the alley.
I turn in the air and correct my heading.
I keep my ki low and fly closer to the ground.

lines.zh: 这条线我熟，闭着眼都能飞。
lines.en: I know this route; I could fly it blind.
My ki wavered and I lurched.
I ride the wind to save strength.

lines.zh: 从这棵树到那棵树，很快。
lines.en: Tree to tree, quick.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面飞，溅起一路。
lines.en: I skim the water and leave a trail of spray.

lines.zh: 落下来的时候，膝盖先弯。
lines.en: On landing, my knees bend first.
I hover and watch the ground.
Floating like this is easier than walking.
Ki holds me up. Steady.

lines.zh: 我把手插进兜里，歇一会儿。
lines.en: I put my hands in my pockets and rest.

lines.zh: 这么多年，飞的姿势还是老样子。
lines.en: All these years, I still fly the same way.
I'm not the strongest, but I can fly.
Wind passes under my feet. Cool.
I raise a hand against the sun.

lines.zh: 下面有人在看我，我装作没看见。
lines.en: Someone below is watching. I pretend not to notice.
I ease down a little lower.

lines.zh: 这一身旧伤，飞起来倒不疼。
lines.en: Oddly, my old wounds don't hurt in the air.
I'm deciding whether to go down.
Half my ki withdrawn, so I don't stand out.

lines.zh: 我吐口气，白雾被风吹散。
lines.en: I exhale and the wind scatters the mist.

lines.zh: 从上面看，你比想象中小。
lines.en: From up here you look smaller than I expected.
I'm landing. Don't tense up.

lines.zh: 你抬头看了很久，我知道。
lines.en: You've been looking up a while. I know.

lines.zh: 我不打算动手，除非你先。
lines.en: I'm not going to fight unless you start.
No ki on you. You're ordinary, aren't you.

lines.zh: 我飞得高，是习惯，不是傲慢。
lines.en: I fly high out of habit, not arrogance.

lines.zh: 要问路就问，我正好闲着。
lines.en: Ask directions if you need them. I'm free.
Step back two paces and I'll come down.

lines.zh: 这么近看我，有点不自在。
lines.en: Being looked at this closely is uncomfortable.
You looked up as I touched down.
I take my hands out of my pockets.

lines.zh: 别以为飞着的人就不会累。
lines.en: Don't think fliers don't get tired.
I drop lower to talk to you.

lines.zh: 你的影子被我的挡住了一部分。
lines.en: My shadow has covered part of yours.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被人从下面盯着。
lines.en: I don't like being stared at from below.
There's no grudge between us, is there.
I spread my hands. Empty.
Since we've met, let's talk.
Knocked out of the sky.
I hit the ground and rolled half over.
My ki scattered. I need to gather it again.
That brings back old memories.
I push off the ground and rise slowly.
Not yet. I can still fly.

lines.zh: 肋骨那里，断没断不知道。
lines.en: Something's wrong with my ribs. Can't tell if broken.
My lip is split. It's nothing.
Don't hit me while I'm landing.
I'm used to this much.
I haven't got much, but I can share.

lines.zh: 是不是想让我下去一趟？
lines.en: Are you trying to get me to come down?
I landed just for this.
Fly long enough and you get hungry.

lines.zh: 这个味道，路上没闻到过。
lines.en: I never smelled this on the road.
I take it and stay standing.
Thanks. Next one's on me.

lines.zh: 我边吃边抬头看看天上。
lines.en: I eat while glancing at the sky.

lines.zh: 你手伸得那么高，我够得着。
lines.en: You hold it up high — I can reach.

lines.zh: 别站太近，我落地时风大。
lines.en: Don't stand too close; I kick up wind.

lines.zh: 我落地没站稳，撞到你了。
lines.en: I landed off-balance and hit you.
My ki slipped and I dropped.
A shoulder bump. Nothing.

lines.zh: 你在我降落点站着，很危险。
lines.en: You stood in my landing spot. Dangerous.
I catch you — don't fall.
My Kamehameha is charged.

lines.zh: 脚下的土被我踩塌了一块。
lines.en: My landing caved a patch of soil.
Sorry, I didn't see you from the air.
Don't jump up; I'll collide with you.
Steady — it's windy around me.

lines.zh: 我不太会说话，你别介意。
lines.en: I'm not much of a talker. Bear with me.
Want me to fly you somewhere?
Don't worry. My grip is firm.
It's windy up there. Hold tight.

lines.zh: 这些年，我总是一个人飞。
lines.en: All these years I've flown alone.

lines.zh: 有个人在旁边，天都好看些。
lines.en: With someone beside me, even the sky looks better.

lines.zh: 我不算靠得住，可我会来。
lines.en: I'm not the most reliable, but I'll show up.
I hover and wait for your nod.
Let's land here. Nice view.
Same place tomorrow night?

lines.zh: 我从半空抓了一把，没抓到。
lines.en: I grab at it from the air and miss.
I land and bend to pick it up.

lines.zh: 我从空中落下来递给你。
lines.en: I drop from the air and hand it to you.
I weigh it. Not heavy.
I reach out and catch it in midair.
I'll carry it a while and give it back.

lines.zh: 地上还有一件，我一起捡。
lines.en: There's another. I'll get both.
This fits in a pocket nicely.
I brush off the dust and hand it over.
I'll pick it up and go. Don't worry.
Your ki changed. I stop.
I saw it from above. Don't pretend.
If we're fighting, I'll stay grounded.
I land and draw my ki in.

lines.zh: 你刚才那下，是冲我来的。
lines.en: That last move was aimed at me.
I'm calculating where to land.
This open space will do.
I raise my hand; light gathers in the palm.
I don't want this fight, but I won't run.

lines.zh: 你站在我正下方，很不利。
lines.en: You're directly below me. Bad position.
I come from above. I have the speed.
Ki's steady. Ready.

lines.zh: 你给我三秒，我考虑一下。
lines.en: Give me three seconds to think.
Fine. Let's do it.

lines.zh: 你的动作我已经记住了。
lines.en: I've memorized your movement.

lines.zh: 我的龟派气功还不够熟练。
lines.en: My Kamehameha still isn't polished.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶，你看不见我。
lines.en: I'm above your head. You can't see me.
I follow you; the wind gives me away.

lines.zh: 你左右看，我就在正上方。
lines.en: You look left and right. I'm straight up.
At this height you can't reach me.
I drop lower to test your reaction.
You raise a hand; I climb.
I circle into your blind spot above.

lines.zh: 你的脚步乱了，说明你急了。
lines.en: Your steps broke. You're getting impatient.
The wind blows east. I come from the west.
I've used this approach many times.

lines.zh: 你在下面转圈，我跟着转。
lines.en: You circle below; I circle with you.
Don't look up too long. Your neck will ache.

lines.zh: 气在我手上，你感觉得到吗？
lines.en: Ki in my hand. Can you feel it?

lines.zh: 我再低一点，你就够到了。
lines.en: A little lower and you could reach me.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边了，空间变小。
lines.en: You've backed to the wall. Less room.
I'm in no hurry to come down.

lines.zh: 你的影子一直在我脚下。
lines.en: Your shadow stays under my feet.
This is when you should be afraid.
I dive from above with one kick.

lines.zh: 落地的气浪先到，人后到。
lines.en: The shockwave lands before I do.
I spin midair and whip my instep across.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑，扫你的腿。
lines.en: I slide low and sweep your legs.
I grab your shoulder and lift.
This punch carries my fall's weight.
I push you toward the wall.
I strike because you moved first.
Ki bursts the soil under my feet.
Strike, then straight up.
You guard high; I come low.
I kick your wrist.
My forearm comes across and pins you.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候，你别站在那。
lines.en: Don't be standing there when I land.
Three blows in one breath.
Don't think all I have is ki blasts.

lines.zh: 我从天上下来，落在你面前。
lines.en: I come down from the sky and land before you.
My ki settles and the wind goes quiet.
The soil pushes out in a ring.

lines.zh: 我飞了很久，才找到这里。
lines.en: I flew a long way to find this place.

lines.zh: 把手从兜里拿出来，站好。
lines.en: Hands out of pockets. Standing straight.
I'm hoping not to fight this trip.
I touch down, knees flexing.
I think I've been here before.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看了一下太阳，辨方向。
lines.en: I glance at the sun to get my bearings.
Ki still turns around me, not yet faded.

lines.zh: 我从高处看下来，觉得不对劲。
lines.en: From above, something looked wrong.
So I came down.

lines.zh: 身上还有飞行时带的风。
lines.en: I still carry the wind from flying.

lines.zh: 我落地时没出声，是故意的。
lines.en: I landed silently. On purpose.

lines.zh: 这么多年，还是这套动作。
lines.en: All these years, same routine.
The wind holds me in midair.
Me landing here was no coincidence.
Feet planted. Let me look around first.
Fire billowed up; I climbed fast.

lines.zh: 气没托住，我直直落下来。
lines.en: My ki failed me and I dropped straight down.

lines.zh: 水里飞不起来，我往下沉。
lines.en: I can't fly underwater. I'm sinking.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我从空中掀下去。
lines.en: The blast swatted me out of the air.
Something's lodged in my thigh.

lines.zh: 这股力气，压得我飞不起来。
lines.en: This force weighs me down; I can't fly.
Flying too long. I'm running dry.

lines.zh: 雷打在空中，我整个人一僵。
lines.en: Lightning struck midair and I locked up.

lines.zh: 这里没有地面，也没有风。
lines.en: No ground here, and no wind either.
